inspection.eyebrow: Built for padel equipment, not generic classifieds
inspection.title: Every listing requires structured court-ready disclosures.
inspection.subtitle: Buying a used racket shouldn't mean guessing from one blurry photo. PadelHub prompts sellers to declare exact frame, face, and packaging details before manual review.
inspection.tabFaceBody: Sellers disclose surface roughness, paint chips, and EVA core firmness so you know how the racket plays before meeting at the club.
inspection.tabFaceMeta: Required: 3–6 clear photos covering both faces
inspection.tabFrameBody: Explicit declaration of glass scuffs versus structural cracks or prior carbon repairs. No hidden surprises when you inspect in person.
inspection.tabBallsBody: Ball listings state exact canister count, packaging seal, and one clear EGP price for the entire bundle—sale only, zero stock confusion.

features.title: Designed around how Egypt's padel community actually trades.
features.subtitle: No middleman markups, no forced escrow, and no noisy social group threads where listings disappear in hours.
features.card1Body: Every submitted listing is checked for complete photos, clear EGP pricing, and honest damage disclosures before appearing in search.
features.card2Body: Browse anonymously without creating an account. When you find the right racket, start a conversation directly with the seller to meet courtside.
features.card3Title: Private by default, shareable by choice
features.card3Body: Sellers control when their profile is public and get a permanent username link and QR code to share at clubs in Cairo, Giza, and Alexandria.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about the marketplace.
faq.q1: Does PadelHub charge commissions or handle checkout?
faq.a1: No. PadelHub is a free connection bridge. Buyers and sellers arrange inspection, payment, and pickup directly with one another in EGP.
faq.q2: Can I swap a racket instead of selling it?
faq.a2: Yes. Racket listings support sale, swap, or both, allowing you to specify the exact model or weight class you are looking to trade for. Padel balls are sale-only.
faq.q3: Do I need an account just to browse or message a seller?
faq.a3: No account is needed to browse equipment or initiate a WhatsApp inquiry once the live marketplace launches. Accounts are only required to create a seller profile and post listings.
faq.q4: Are the listings on this page available to buy right now?
faq.a4: Not yet. The items shown here are clearly labeled demo fixtures and AI-generated illustrations created to preview the marketplace experience.
